title: The Witness Without a Face
evidence_boundary: DMT experiences are subjective and do not establish that perceived entities, souls, or realms exist independently of the brain.

scenes.text: People describe DMT as leaving the body. The stranger possibility is that you leave the person.
scenes.visual: a human silhouette stepping out of its own framed portrait into a vast dark gallery

scenes.text: At first, the familiar pieces loosen: your name, your age, the room, the reason you came.
scenes.visual: an identity card, pocket watch, room key, and empty chair drifting apart above a table

scenes.text: We usually imagine those things are masks, and beneath them waits a truer face.
scenes.visual: a row of theater masks being lifted from a blank mannequin head

scenes.text: But what if the final layer is not another face?
scenes.visual: a featureless polished mask suspended alone inside a black display case

scenes.text: Your biography disappears first, like a passport dropped into deep water.
scenes.visual: an open passport sinking underwater as its ink dissolves into blue currents

scenes.text: Then the body becomes a rumor being repeated somewhere very far away.
scenes.visual: a distant human outline made from radio static fading across an empty salt flat

scenes.text: Time loses its sequence. Before and after spill from their containers and mix on the floor.
scenes.visual: broken clocks and hourglasses spilling gears and colored sand across a tiled floor

scenes.text: And still, somehow, the disappearance is being noticed.
scenes.visual: a single glowing ember suspended at the center of an immense unlit chamber

scenes.text: That is the impossible little ember at the center of the experience.
scenes.visual: a tiny coal glowing beneath layers of pale ash while the surrounding hearth is cold

scenes.text: Something witnesses the self vanish, but it cannot introduce itself without building a new self.
scenes.visual: an empty wooden chair facing a projection of a person that is breaking into particles

scenes.text: Ask the witness its name, and you have already handed it a mask.
scenes.visual: two hands placing an ornate mask onto a smooth faceless sculpture

scenes.text: It is like a flashlight trying to turn around and illuminate the bulb producing its light.
scenes.visual: a flashlight beam curving through a cave and bending back toward its own glass lens

scenes.text: Or a mirror searching its own surface for the reflection that makes reflection possible.
scenes.visual: a corridor of standing mirrors reflecting only other mirrors and pale daylight

scenes.text: Imagine a house going dark room by room: childhood, ambition, fear, even the room marked me.
scenes.visual: a cutaway dollhouse whose rooms switch off one by one from top floor to basement

scenes.text: At the end, one open window remains, watching a sunrise with nobody standing behind it.
scenes.visual: an abandoned house interior with one open window framing a brilliant sunrise

scenes.text: Is that window a soul, a brain process, or simply what awareness feels like without its furniture?
scenes.visual: an empty laboratory chair beside quiet neural monitors and a sunlit window

scenes.text: DMT cannot settle that argument. It may only remove the furniture faster than language can replace it.
scenes.visual: a bright white room where a sofa, bookshelf, and lamp dissolve into dust

scenes.text: The mind then rushes to decorate the emptiness with gods, machines, ancestors, and impossible beings.
scenes.visual: a sculpture studio crowded with unfinished deities, clockwork figures, and ancestral busts

scenes.text: Perhaps those figures are visitors. Perhaps they are shadows cast when awareness meets its own depth.
scenes.visual: enormous unfamiliar shadows converging around a small lamp at the bottom of a stone well

scenes.text: Either way, the witness itself never appears as an object in the room.
scenes.visual: an art gallery with illuminated objects surrounding one empty central pedestal

scenes.text: Music can fill a cathedral without becoming another instrument on the stage.
scenes.visual: a cathedral nave filled with visible ripples of sound above a single violin

scenes.text: Then ordinary consciousness returns, rebuilding the walls, hanging your name back above the door.
scenes.visual: workers rebuilding a small room while a framed portrait is returned above the doorway

scenes.text: You feel as though the witness returned with you. But perhaps it was the one thing that never traveled.
scenes.visual: a trail of footprints circling a lighthouse that has remained fixed through changing weather

scenes.text: If your face can disappear while seeing remains, which one have you been calling yourself?
scenes.visual: a fogged mirror with no reflection except a steady eye-shaped point of light
